title: We need your feedback on effector gene prediction!
summary: Please let us know your thoughts on the prediction of effector genes for common diseases and traits by filling out this brief survey.
bodyHtml: We are gathering community feedback to help us shape a hybrid workshop in September 2024 on standards for predicting sets of effector genes for complex diseases and traits. Please fill out the survey below, or access it directly here, and enter your contact information at the end to receive more information on the workshop.
